shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index dropped 95 points or 0.18 percent on Friday to close at 51683 points.Losses were led by IBM (-3.19%), Walt Disney (-2.68%) and Nike (-2.26%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Amgen (1.54%), Nvidia (1.33%) and Caterpillar (1.20%).

children: The Dow Jones Index dropped 95 points or 0.18 percent on Friday to close at 51683 points.

title: The Dow Jones Index Closes 0.18% Lower
